clauses.clause_text: Banks shall maintain Cash Reserve Ratio as prescribed by the Reserve Bank of India under Section 42 of the RBI Act, 1934
Banks shall maintain Statutory Liquidity Ratio in accordance with RBI directions issued under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949
Customer KYC verification is mandatory for all new account openings in compliance with RBI norms and guidelines
Anti-money laundering checks and suspicious transaction reporting is mandatory as per RBI directions
Liquidity Coverage Ratio must be maintained as per Basel III guidelines notified by RBI
